/subscribed/subtitle.v: Jonga ibhokisi lakho le-imeyile ezingenayo ukuze ufumane i-imeyile yokuqinisekisa.

/form/intro.v: Ushicilelo olutsha lufika nge-imeyile, lubhalwe ngolwimi oluchongileyo.

/form/nameHint.v: Silisebenzisela ukukubulisa. Ukuba ulishiya lingenanto, sisebenzisa isiqalo sedilesi yakho ye-imeyile.

/form/consent.v: Ngokubhalisa, uyavuma ukufumana ii-imeyile ezivela ku-{sender}. I-imeyile nganye inelinki yokuyeka ukubhalisa.

/success/body.v: Sithumele i-imeyile yokuqinisekisa ku-{email}. Yivule uze ukhethe Qinisekisa ubhaliso.

/success/next.v: Ushicilelo lwakho lokuqala lufika emva kokuba uqinisekisile, lubhalwe nge-{language}.

/success/spam.v: Ukuba akukho nto ifikayo kwimizuzu embalwa, jonga kwifolda ye-spam okanye ye-Promotions.

/errors/emailInvalid.v: Le dilesi ye-imeyile ibonakala ingaphelelanga. Yijonge uze uzame kwakhona.

/errors/missingLink.v: Le linki yobhaliso ayinalo lonke ulwazi. Cela ilinki entsha kumthumeli.

/errors/notFound.v: Le linki yobhaliso ayisasebenzi. Cela ilinki entsha kumthumeli.

/errors/limit.v: Le ncwadana yeendaba ayikwazi ukwamkela ababhalisi abatsha okwangoku. Zama kwakhona kamva.

/errors/invalid.v: Asikwazanga ukwamkela le dilesi. Yijonge uze uzame kwakhona.

/errors/server.v: Asikwazanga ukugcina ubhaliso lwakho. Zama kwakhona emva kwexeshana.

/errors/network.v: Asikwazanga ukufikelela kwiseva. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwakho uze uzame kwakhona.

/confirm/body.v: Khetha iqhosha ukuze uqalise ukufumana ushicilelo ku-{email}.

/confirm/consent.v: Ngokuqinisekisa, uyavuma ukufumana le ncwadana yeendaba nge-imeyile. Ungayeka ukubhalisa kulo naluphi na ushicilelo.

/confirm/successTip.v: Ukuze lungangeni kwi-spam, yongeza umthumeli koonxibelelana nabo.

/confirm/invalidBody.v: Vula kwakhona i-imeyile yokuqinisekisa uze ukhethe iqhosha layo. Ukuba awuyifumani, bhalisa kwakhona kwiphepha lomthumeli.

/confirm/notFoundBody.v: Asibufumananga ubhaliso lwale dilesi. Bhalisa kwakhona kwiphepha lomthumeli.

/confirm/errorBody.v: Asikwazanga ukuqinisekisa ubhaliso lwakho. Zama kwakhona emva kwexeshana.

/embed/intro.v: Ncamathisela enye yezi khowudi kwiwebhusayithi yakho. Abantu ababhalisayo bafumana i-imeyile yokuqinisekisa, emva koko bafumane ushicilelo lwakho ngolwimi lwabo.

/embed/linkHint.v: Yabelana ngayo kwi-bio yeendaba zentlalo, kwisignesha ye-imeyile, okanye kwikhowudi ye-QR.

/embed/scriptHint.v: Yincamathisele apho ifomu kufuneka ivele khona. Ifomu ilungisa ubungakanani bayo ngokwayo.

/embed/iframeHint.v: Sebenzisa oku ukuba isayithi yakho ayivumeli ii-script.

/embed/accentHint.v: Yishiye injalo ukuze usebenzise umbala wophawu lwakho.

/embed/previewNote.v: Le mbonakalo yangaphambili iyasebenza ngokwenene. Ukubhalisa apha kwenza umbhalisi wokwenene.

/embed/missing.v: Qala wenze incwadana yeendaba. Ifomu yobhaliso iza kuvela apha xa ikhona.

/signature/intro.v: Abafundi babona oku ekupheleni koshicilelo ngalunye. Cofa nayiphi na indawo yembonakalo yangaphambili ukuze uyihlele.

/signature/showHint.v: Ukuba uyicima, ushicilelo luphela emva kwenqaku.

/signature/previewEmpty.v: Isignesha yakho ayinanto. Yongeza igama lakho ukuze uqalise.

/signature/blocksHint.v: Khetha ithegi ukuze ubonise okanye ufihle elo candelo. Amacandelo afihliweyo agcina umbhalo wawo.

/signature/hints/photoUrl.v: Ilinki eya kwi-PNG okanye i-JPG esisikwere, ubuncinci ii-pixel ezili-144 x 144 kwaye ingaphantsi kwe-200 KB. Iboniswa ngee-pixel ezingama-72 x 72 ecaleni kwegama lakho.

/signature/hints/logoUrl.v: Ilinki eya kwi-PNG okanye i-JPG enomva obonakalayo okanye omhlophe, ubuncinci ii-pixel ezingama-64 ukuphakama. Iboniswa ngokuphakama kwee-pixel ezingama-32.

/signature/hints/cta.v: Kufuneka zombini umbhalo nelinki ukuze iqhosha libonakale.

/signature/hints/disclaimer.v: Umbhalo omncinci ezantsi, umzekelo inqaku lemfihlo. Yishiye ingenanto ukuba awuyidingi.

/signature/style/accentHint.v: Usetyenziselwa ibha, iilinki neqhosha. Uqala ngombala wophawu lwakho.

/signature/resetConfirm.v: Khetha kwakhona ukuze ucime onke amasimi
